title: didymoglossum humile
intro: Didymoglossum humile, commonly known as the dwarf resurrection fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Didymoglossum humile are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of these conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
